title: Global action/keyboard shortcut for existing functionality of toggling audio mute of the currently active window/application
line: A new "Mute Active Application" shortcut (Alt+Mute by default) mutes or unmutes just the app of the focused window.
explanation: Muting a single application was only possible with the mouse, through the Task Manager's audio badge or the Audio Volume applet; there was no global shortcut for it. The audio shortcuts live in plasma-pa's kded module, which can't see windows on Wayland, and KWin had no D-Bus call that returns the active window. KWin now exposes getActiveWindowInfo (same map as getWindowInfo), and plasma-pa adds a "Mute Active Application" action to the Audio Volume shortcuts that asks KWin for the active window, finds its streams the way the Task Manager does (portal app id, then PID, then parent PID in the same cgroup) and toggles them, with an OSD such as "Firefox muted".

commits.message:
dbusinterface: add getActiveWindowInfo

There was no D-Bus call to get the active window, which plasma-pa
needs to mute the active application. Add getActiveWindowInfo, which
returns the same window information as getWindowInfo.

CCBUG: 469976

kded: add a shortcut to mute the active application

Muting one app was only possible with the mouse. Add a Mute Active
Application shortcut, Alt+Mute by default, that asks KWin for the
active window and toggles its app's streams like the Task Manager.

BUG: 469976

patches.diff:
From be1e592dd62fe1691ed5913faf7fc6a5cfdf661f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 22:14:35 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] dbusinterface: add getActiveWindowInfo

There was no D-Bus call to get the active window, which plasma-pa
needs to mute the active application. Add getActiveWindowInfo, which
returns the same window information as getWindowInfo.

CCBUG: 469976
---
 src/dbusinterface.cpp | 10 ++++++++++
 src/dbusinterface.h   |  5 +++++
 src/org.kde.KWin.xml  |  4 ++++
 3 files changed, 19 insertions(+)

diff --git a/src/dbusinterface.cpp b/src/dbusinterface.cpp
index 6110ddfe64..e357a264f1 100644
--- a/src/dbusinterface.cpp
+++ b/src/dbusinterface.cpp
@@ -187,6 +187,16 @@ QVariantMap DBusInterface::getWindowInfo(const QString &uuid)
     }
 }
 
+QVariantMap DBusInterface::getActiveWindowInfo()
+{
+    const auto window = workspace()->activeWindow();
+    if (window) {
+        return clientToVariantMap(window);
+    } else {
+        return {};
+    }
+}
+
 void DBusInterface::showDesktop(bool show)
 {
     workspace()->setShowingDesktop(show, true);
diff --git a/src/dbusinterface.h b/src/dbusinterface.h
index ebabdef1bc..b226098cb8 100644
--- a/src/dbusinterface.h
+++ b/src/dbusinterface.h
@@ -86,6 +86,11 @@ public Q_SLOTS: // METHODS
      */
     QVariantMap getWindowInfo(const QString &uuid);
 
+    /**
+     * Returns a map with information about the active window, or an empty map if there is none.
+     */
+    QVariantMap getActiveWindowInfo();
+
     Q_NOREPLY void showDesktop(bool show);
 
 Q_SIGNALS:
diff --git a/src/org.kde.KWin.xml b/src/org.kde.KWin.xml
index b073a71cd5..625cfdf486 100644
--- a/src/org.kde.KWin.xml
+++ b/src/org.kde.KWin.xml
@@ -35,6 +35,10 @@
         <arg type="s" direction="in"/>
         <arg type="a{sv}" direction="out"/>
     </method>
+    <method name="getActiveWindowInfo">
+        <annotation name="org.qtproject.QtDBus.QtTypeName.Out0" value="QVariantMap"/>
+        <arg type="a{sv}" direction="out"/>
+    </method>
 
     <property name="showingDesktop" type="b" access="read"/>
     <method name="showDesktop">
--

media.caption: Audio Volume shortcuts: no action for the active application
New "Mute Active Application" action, Alt+Volume Mute by default
Two players playing, Player A focused, Alt+Mute pressed: nothing happens
Same press: only Player A's stream is muted (Player B keeps playing) and the OSD says so
